reviews.review_description: FINALLY!!!! A good guest 3 trucking game!!!…. I’m a ex truck driver ( I gave 1 year of my life to U.S.Xpress unfortunately 😒 ) and being a employee rather than a owner op I grew to hate truck driving but I did love the travel and very slight freedom so I have been wanting a good truck driving game in VR  and this one is very, very good…. Now I don’t want to be one of those guys that demand features knowing it’s very difficult to make games without breaking something and then everybody jumps on you for it but I do really believe in this game and want to give some recommendations coming from a person that really drive trucks for a living…. Quickly though; I love that you have to fill gas up and it takes a good chunk of your money, that’s very realistic ( people that have never drove a truck will complain about that so get ready 😂 ) and I love that you have to eat/drink to maintain saintly….. now 1: the most obvious one first; I hope you guys make the map bigger. I drove primarily on the east coast but have been to the west and particularly Arizona and it’s a great place to base the game in being that the desert has very long stretches of roads and highways that you guys can capture amazingly if you do expand….. 2: the car wash thing is great and quick but I’m telling you now if you want real truckers to get into this game you gotta add a feature where you can manually wash the truck with at least a little water hose. It doesn’t have to be in great detail, just a little aim and shoot type thing to get the dirt off ( again I know this is quest and it can’t handle but so much detail and mechanics) some truck drivers value keeping their rigs clean and love doing it on their own…. 3: I am a bit lazy when playing a driving game so I like to sit the entire time, this game made me stand up when I need to stand up outside of the truck which I love and is more immersive but please add a auto height mechanic that has you standing even if you’re sitting when you’re outside the truck but auto corrects you to a sitting position when you get in the truck. Just a nit picky feature I’d like to see…. 4: I’m sure you guys are gonna add a weather system and night and day cycle in the future but yeah, that would be nice…. 5: the cabin in the truck could get utilized for sleeping instead of having to go back to the garage ( I mean that’s what they are for in real life after all 😂 ) and maybe add a little tv back there with a small mini game to play or connect to YouTube or something. Again I know this is meta platform so limitations do exist and I don’t want you guys to break the game, I’m just giving creature comfort ideas to keep people immersed if you can….. and that’s it that I can think of….. PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE don’t abandon this game!!!! It has very real potential to me.

developer_response.body:
Hi!

It's amazing to see such a detailed review, that's exactly what we need!
Love to hear from someone that has an actual trucking experience.
So let me try to give you as detailed answer to the points you've made as possible.
1. Making more space would be amazing and this is something we have on the back of our minds all the time, as of now you can unlock new regions and travel between them through highways. For now we want to focus on making these places as detailed and working as best as possible.  Optimization in that kind of a game is very important, which is also why we've decided to split everything into smaller maps, which still leaves the room for expansion. So once we make the current maps and road systems perfect, we can think about expanding.
2. Self washing the truck is actually something we thought about as well! For now we're of course focused on more important things such as balancing and improving the traffic, but the time will definitely come for that kind of a feature. We are aware that giving you more, even simple interactions, will make the experience more and more immersive, so it's great to see those ideas!
3.  As of now your height is taken directly from how your boarders are setup on your quest. We will definitely look into that, simply because you're right. It's a driving experience, not run around experience and the comfort of siting is something  very important.  We will look into that and find the best solution so you can enjoy the game without the need to constantly stand up.
4. We already have rain in our game that is in fact influencing how you drive! Roads are more slippery during that time so you have to be more careful. But yes, weather system is something to be expanded. About day and night cycles, we want to add night shifts in the future which will bring new challenges and bigger rewards.
5. Sleeping is made the way it is since it's directly connected to the save system, so it is a little more tricky but we see that more and more people are interested in actually sleeping in the truck. We will definitely think of a way to make that possible since your word is very important for us. Talking about back of the truck, mini games are a great idea! Utilizing the back like that would be great, we'd love to add something like that. Just keep in mind that currently we're more focused on improving and perfecting the main gameplay, but once we have a little bit more space for things like that, why not!

If you'd want to give us even more feedback in the future, join our discord community server! You can find a link to it on our store page.

Once again, love the feedback!

reviews.review_description:
Fancy hitting the open road without leaving your living room? Then this is for you. There’s something really satisfying about getting behind the wheel, taking in the surroundings and enjoying the freedom of the road in VR. A lovely change of pace from all the shooting, zombies and frantic action games out there. Lots of missions and money to be made, I just have to remember to drive on the worng side of the road lol..

If you enjoy driving and simulation games, this is well worth checking out. Plenty of potential here, and I’m looking forward to seeing how it develops with future updates. Five stars from me — time to put the kettle on, climb into the cab and get those virtual wheels rolling

developer_response.body:
Thank you for your review!

We're extremely glad you loved our game!
Be sure to check it out from time to time since we're in Early Access the game is only going to get better and better.

See you on the road!

reviews.review_description:
Absolutely loving this so far, love the story, Grandpa’s voice is reassuring and calming, the mechanic’s work so well, I really feel like I’m pulling my load.

Now coming from the UK I keep driving on the wrong side of the road, I’m an idiot, two police fines for going through red lights that I failed to see, anymore and I will lose my license.

The whole feel of the game is just so nice, the Arizona desert is an empty place, but the tarmac is smooth.

Awesome from the dev team and so active updating any issues, plays really well for an early access game.
If you love chilled driving this is a must game to add to your collection.

developer_response.body:
Hi!

We're glad you've loved the game!
It's great to see so many pleasant words.
As to your driving I'm sure you'll get used to driving on the other side of the road with enough practice!

We're updating the game often so be sure to follow the patch notes!

Thank you for your review!

reviews.review_description: This game is a blast I'm having lots of fun Best trucking game on the Oculus quest 3 lots of missions you get to eat food travel to different regions picking up different loads I like to travels the trucks look good the graphics good I like you can get out your truck and walk around the horn needs to be updated I will definitely recommend this game to anybody that likes to drive trucks relax enjoy the music and drop your loads off make that money and you can hire people to drive for you that's cool lots of doing this game can't wait to see more see you on the road truckers. When it comes to Long hauls you get tired at the worstest time it's like you don't know when it's going to happen until it happens since there's no indicator showing that you're getting close to sleepy but when it do happens you know where near a rest area or a gas station that has a rest area to pull over to rest and I think when you do that it shouldn't cancel your trip or your delivery you should be able to get some rest and be able to still make your delivery to the destination instead of you canceling out your delivery unless you have no choice but to go back home  and I think some of the gas stations should be different types of gas stations instead of the same logo in color different types of gas station and if you can add a rest area along the side of the highway where you can pull into there and rest maybe grab a snack if you can can you add like different restaurants to look at as you travel more different billboards can't wait till night time driving it's going to be a blast the city be late at night you can pull into a restaurant go to the drive-thru and pull up to the window where it shows your order scan your watch pick the food you want and then pull around to the window to pick up the food and if you can can you add more food choices nuggets french fries fish sandwich keep up the good work love what you doing

developer_response.body:
Hi!

We're glad you enjoyed our game!

You've made some great points when it comes to resting on the road.
We are already working on placing many resting spots around the Arizona so that issue soon will be dealt with!
When it comes to variety of different gas stations, it's definitely something to think about, might make the world feel more alive.

Thank you for such a detailed review!

reviews.review_description: The only thing I wish it had is stop signs, and please the ability to steer with the joystick.

Overall traffic improvement is on our list to do so this is something that will definitely change.
The suggestion about being able to steer with the joystick is great, we will add it with a pleasure, the comfort of gameplay is very important for us!
